answer: The employer must provide at least two exit routes, unless the number of employees, size, occupancy, or arrangement requires more. The routes must be located as far apart as practical.
key_facts: more than two may be required
quote: At least two exit routes must be available in a workplace.

answer: Yes. Exit signs must be illuminated and clearly visible. Section 1910.37 does not prescribe a specific letter color; it requires a sign reading “EXIT” and suitable illumination.
quote: Each exit must be clearly visible and marked by a sign reading “Exit.”

answer: A written emergency action plan must include emergency-reporting procedures; evacuation procedures and routes; procedures for employees who remain for critical operations; accounting for employees after evacuation; rescue and medical duties; and contact information for responsible persons.
key_facts: procedures for reporting a fire or other emergency
procedures to account for all employees
quote: Procedures for reporting a fire or other emergency

answer: A fire prevention plan must identify major fire hazards, hazardous-material handling and storage procedures, ignition-source controls, combustible-waste procedures, maintenance of heat-producing equipment, and responsible personnel. The plan must be kept in writing and made available to employees.
key_facts: procedures for controlling accumulations of flammable and combustible waste
names or job titles of personnel responsible
quote: A fire prevention plan must be in writing, be kept in the workplace, and be made available to employees

answer: Portable fire extinguishers must be visually inspected monthly and maintained at least annually. They must also be maintained whenever an inspection indicates the need.
key_facts: maintenance at least once every year
when an inspection indicates the need
quote: Portable fire extinguishers shall be visually inspected monthly.

answer: An employee alarm system must provide warning for required emergency action, be distinctive and recognizable, be perceived above ambient noise or light levels, and notify employees exposed to the emergency. The system must be maintained and tested as required by the standard.
key_facts: provide warning for necessary emergency action
perceived above ambient noise or light levels
quote: The employee alarm system must provide warning for necessary emergency action

answer: Fire-brigade members must receive training before participating in emergency activities, with training commensurate with their duties and responsibilities. Members involved in interior structural firefighting must receive initial and at least annual training.
key_facts: training commensurate with duties and responsibilities
initial and at least annual training
quote: The employer shall provide training and education for fire brigade members commensurate with those duties and responsibilities

answer: The distance between rungs on a fixed ladder must be uniform and between 10 and 14 inches. The maximum spacing is therefore 14 inches.
quote: The distance between rungs, cleats, and steps does not exceed 14 inches and is uniform throughout the length of the ladder

answer: The top edge of a guardrail system must be 42 inches, plus or minus 3 inches, above the working surface.
quote: The height of the top edge of the top rails, or equivalent guardrail system members, are 42 inches, plus or minus 3 inches

answer: In general industry, fall protection is required when employees are exposed to an unprotected side or edge that is 4 feet or more above a lower level, subject to the exceptions in the standard.
quote: The employer must ensure that each employee on a walking-working surface with an unprotected side or edge that is 4 feet or more above a lower level is protected

answer: Employees exposed to fall hazards, employees using fall-protection systems, and employees performing related work must be trained by a qualified person. Retraining is required when employees lack the required understanding or skill, or when workplace, equipment, or fall-protection changes create new hazards.
key_facts: before exposure to a fall hazard
retraining when changes or deficiencies occur
quote: The employer must ensure that each employee is trained by a qualified person

answer: Walking-working surfaces must be maintained in a clean, orderly, and sanitary condition and free of hazards such as spills, leaks, loose boards, corrosion, snow, and ice.
key_facts: promptly and properly correct or guard hazards
quote: The employer must ensure that each walking-working surface is maintained in a clean, orderly, and sanitary condition

answer: An anchorage for a personal fall-arrest system must support at least 5,000 pounds for each employee attached, or be designed, installed, and used under the supervision of a qualified person as part of a complete system with a safety factor of at least 2.
quote: Capable of supporting at least 5,000 pounds for each employee attached

answer: A rope descent system may be used only when the building owner provides written assurance that each anchorage has been identified, tested, certified, and maintained. Employees must use required personal fall protection, inspect the system before use, and receive training.
key_facts: written assurance from the building owner
quote: The building owner must inform the employer in writing that the building has identified, tested, certified, and maintained each anchorage

answer: Powered platforms for exterior building maintenance must meet requirements for design, suspension, inspection, maintenance, emergency operation, guardrails, personal fall protection, and trained operators. The equipment must be inspected and maintained according to the standard and manufacturer requirements.
quote: The employer shall ensure that all powered platforms are inspected, maintained, and operated in accordance with this section

answer: Aerial lifts and vehicle-mounted elevating work platforms must be inspected before use, operated only by trained and authorized employees, and used according to manufacturer instructions. Employees must use required platform guarding and personal fall protection and must not climb or stand on rails.
key_facts: do not climb or stand on guardrails
quote: Only trained persons shall operate an aerial lift

answer: A hearing conservation program is required when employee noise exposure reaches an 8-hour time-weighted average of 85 dBA, or an equivalent dose of 50 percent.
quote: The employer shall administer a continuing, effective hearing conservation program ... at or above an 8-hour time-weighted average of 85 decibels

answer: Employees using tight-fitting respirators must be fit tested before initial use, whenever the respirator facepiece changes, and at least annually thereafter.
key_facts: whenever the employee changes respirator models, styles, or sizes
quote: The employee must be fit tested ... prior to initial use ... and at least annually thereafter

answer: Yes. The employer must provide a medical evaluation before the employee is fit tested or required to use a respirator in the workplace.
quote: Before the employee is fit tested or required to use the respirator in the workplace

answer: The employer must assess the workplace to determine whether hazards require PPE and must verify the assessment in writing. The certification must identify the workplace evaluated, the date of the assessment, and the person certifying it.
key_facts: identity of the person certifying the assessment
quote: The employer shall verify that the required workplace hazard assessment has been performed through a written certification

answer: Employees must use eye or face protection when exposed to hazards from flying particles, molten metal, liquid chemicals, acids or caustic liquids, chemical gases or vapors, or potentially harmful light radiation. Side shields are required when there is a hazard from flying objects.
key_facts: liquid chemicals, acids, or caustic liquids
quote: The employer shall ensure that each affected employee uses equipment with side protection

answer: Head protection is required when employees are exposed to falling objects, flying objects, or electrical shock and burns. Protective helmets must meet the applicable consensus standard or be demonstrated equally effective.
quote: The employer shall ensure that each affected employee wears a protective helmet

answer: Protective footwear is required where there is a danger of foot injuries from falling or rolling objects, objects piercing the sole, or electrical hazards. The footwear must meet the applicable consensus standard or be equally effective.
quote: The employer shall ensure that each affected employee uses protective footwear

answer: Employers must select and require appropriate hand protection whenever employees’ hands are exposed to hazards such as skin absorption, cuts, lacerations, abrasions, punctures, chemical burns, thermal burns, or harmful temperature extremes.
quote: Employers shall select and require employees to use appropriate hand protection

answer: Rubber insulating gloves must be electrically tested before first issue and every 6 months thereafter. They must also be retested after repair and whenever there is reason to suspect their insulating ability has been affected.
quote: Electrical testing shall be performed before first issue and every 6 months thereafter

answer: Each energy-control procedure must be inspected at least annually to ensure that it complies with the standard and that the procedure is being followed.
quote: The periodic inspection shall be performed at least annually

answer: A tag may replace a lock only when the energy-isolating device cannot accept a lock. When tagout is used, the employer must provide employee protection equivalent to lockout through additional safety measures.
key_facts: energy-isolating device is not capable of being locked out
quote: When a tagout device is used on an energy isolating device which is capable of being locked out

answer: Before entry, the permit must identify the space, purpose, duration, authorized entrants, attendants, entry supervisor, hazards, acceptable entry conditions, test results, rescue procedures, communication procedures, required equipment, and other applicable permits.
quote: Before entry is authorized, the completed permit shall be made available for review at the time of entry

answer: The attendant must remain outside the permit space, continuously monitor entrants, communicate with them, order evacuation when required, summon rescue services, prevent unauthorized entry, and perform no duty that interferes with monitoring.
key_facts: continuously maintain an accurate count of entrants
summon rescue and other emergency services
quote: Knows the hazards that may be faced during entry, including information on the mode, signs or symptoms, and consequences of the exposure

answer: Each powered-industrial-truck operator’s performance must be evaluated at least once every 3 years. Additional evaluation is required when an operator is assigned a different truck type or workplace condition changes.
key_facts: additional training or evaluation when conditions change
quote: The employer shall ensure that each operator has been evaluated at least once every three years

answer: Battery-charging areas must be designated, protected from damage, adequately ventilated, provided with fire-protection equipment, and equipped for flushing and neutralizing spilled electrolyte. Smoking and open flames are prohibited, and proper PPE must be used.
quote: Battery charging installations shall be located in areas designated for that purpose

answer: Overhead cranes require frequent inspections at daily-to-monthly intervals, depending on use and service conditions, and periodic inspections at intervals of 1 to 12 months, depending on activity and environment.
quote: Frequent inspection—Daily to monthly intervals

answer: A sling must be removed from service immediately when it is defective or damaged, including broken wires, severe wear, kinking, crushing, stretching, heat or chemical damage, defective fittings, or illegible identification.
quote: Synthetic web slings shall be immediately removed from service if any of the following conditions are present

answer: Machines must be guarded to protect employees from point-of-operation hazards, ingoing nip points, rotating parts, flying chips, and sparks. Guards must be attached where possible and must not create an accident hazard.
key_facts: guards shall not create an accident hazard
quote: One or more methods of machine guarding shall be provided to protect the operator and other employees in the machine area

answer: The work-rest opening on a grinding machine must not exceed 1/8 inch.
quote: Work rests shall be kept adjusted closely to the wheel with a maximum opening of one-eighth inch

answer: Mechanical power presses must have point-of-operation safeguarding, proper controls, anti-repeat protection, and inspection and maintenance procedures. Two-hand controls must require concurrent operation and be located so the operator cannot reach the danger zone during the closing cycle.
key_facts: prevent the operator from reaching the danger zone
quote: The employer shall provide and ensure the use of point-of-operation devices

answer: Exposed belts, pulleys, gears, sprockets, chains, shafts, flywheels, and other power-transmission parts must be guarded when employees could contact them. Guards must prevent contact with moving parts and be securely attached.
key_facts: shafts and projecting keys or set screws
quote: All belts, pulleys, chains, and gears shall be guarded

answer: Woodworking machinery must have guards that protect employees from points of operation, rotating parts, flying chips, and kickbacks. Table saws require an upper hood guard, a spreader, and anti-kickback devices where specified.
quote: Each circular rip saw shall be guarded by a hood which shall cover the portion of the saw above the table

answer: Portable powered tools must have required guards installed and maintained. Circular saws require upper and lower guards, and portable abrasive wheels require suitable guards; employees may not remove or bypass required guards.
key_facts: upper and lower guards on circular saws
quote: All portable, power-driven circular saws shall be equipped with guards above and below the base plate or shoe

answer: Where employees may be exposed to injurious corrosive materials, suitable facilities for quick drenching or flushing of the eyes and body must be provided within the work area for immediate emergency use.
key_facts: quick drenching or flushing of the eyes and body
quote: Suitable facilities for quick drenching or flushing of the eyes and body shall be provided within the work area

answer: The minimum number of water closets is 1 for 1–15 employees, 2 for 16–35, 3 for 36–55, 4 for 56–80, 5 for 81–110, and 1 additional fixture for each additional 40 employees over 110.
key_facts: 1 additional for each additional 40 employees over 110
quote: 1 for 1 to 15 employees

answer: A shipped chemical label must include the product identifier, signal word, hazard statements, pictograms, precautionary statements, and supplier identification. An SDS must use the required 16-section format and include the information specified in Appendix D.
quote: Each label shall include product identifier; signal word; hazard statement(s); pictogram(s); precautionary statement(s); and the name, address, and telephone number of the chemical manufacturer

answer: Yes. Employers must make the hepatitis B vaccine and vaccination series available at no cost to employees with occupational exposure, generally within 10 working days of initial assignment, unless an exception applies.
key_facts: hepatitis B vaccine and vaccination series
within 10 working days of initial assignment
quote: The hepatitis B vaccination and vaccination series shall be made available at no cost to the employee

answer: The permissible exposure limits for listed air contaminants are found in Table Z-1 of 1910.1000. Tables Z-2 and Z-3 contain additional substance-specific limits.
key_facts: 8-hour time-weighted average, ceiling, and peak limits where listed
quote: Table Z-1—Limits for Air Contaminants

answer: The asbestos permissible exposure limit is 0.1 fiber per cubic centimeter of air as an 8-hour time-weighted average. The excursion limit is 1.0 fiber per cubic centimeter over 30 minutes.
quote: The employer shall ensure that no employee is exposed to an airborne concentration of asbestos in excess of 0.1 fiber per cubic centimeter of air as an eight-hour time-weighted average

answer: For benzene, the permissible exposure limit is 1 ppm as an 8-hour TWA and 5 ppm as a 15-minute STEL. Exposure monitoring and medical surveillance are required when the applicable action levels, exposure durations, or job categories in the standard are met.
quote: The employer shall assure that no employee is exposed to an airborne concentration of benzene in excess of 1 ppm as an 8-hour time-weighted average

answer: Under the general-industry lead standard, medical removal is required when periodic and follow-up blood sampling indicates a blood lead level at or above 50 µg/dL.
quote: The employer shall remove an employee from work having an exposure to lead at or above the action level when the employee’s blood lead level is at or above 50 µg/dL

answer: The permissible exposure limit for respirable crystalline silica is 50 µg/m³ as an 8-hour TWA. The action level is 25 µg/m³ as an 8-hour TWA.
quote: The employer shall ensure that no employee is exposed to an airborne concentration of respirable crystalline silica in excess of 50 μg/m3, calculated as an 8-hour TWA

answer: Employee exposure records must generally be maintained for 30 years. Employee medical records must generally be maintained for the duration of employment plus 30 years, subject to the exceptions in the standard.
quote: Exposure records shall be preserved and maintained for at least thirty (30) years

answer: Electrical equipment must have a clear working space at least 30 inches wide, with depth generally 3–4 feet depending on voltage and conditions. Required headroom is generally at least 6 feet 6 inches.
quote: The width of working space in front of the electric equipment shall be the width of the equipment or 30 inches, whichever is greater

answer: Cord-and-plug equipment must have an approved grounding method, an effective ground-fault current path, and a grounding-type receptacle where required. Grounding prongs may not be removed, and equipment-grounding conductors may not be interrupted.
quote: The path to ground from circuits, equipment, and enclosures shall be permanent, continuous, and effective

answer: Only qualified persons may work on exposed energized parts. Circuits must be deenergized before work when possible, locked or tagged out, and verified deenergized by a qualified person; energized work is allowed only when permitted by the standard.
quote: Live parts to which an employee will be exposed shall be deenergized before the employee works on or near them

answer: Before welding or cutting near combustibles, remove or protect combustibles within 35 feet, inspect the opposite side of walls and floors, provide suitable fire extinguishing equipment, and assign a fire watch when required.
quote: Combustible material shall be relocated at least 35 feet horizontally from the work site

answer: Oxygen cylinders must be stored at least 20 feet from fuel-gas cylinders or separated by a noncombustible barrier at least 5 feet high with a fire-resistance rating of at least one-half hour.
quote: They shall be separated by a minimum distance of 20 feet or by a noncombustible barrier at least 5 feet high

answer: A flammable-liquid storage cabinet must be approved or constructed as required, properly marked, and limited to 120 gallons total. No more than 60 gallons may be Category 1, 2, or 3 flammable or combustible liquid.
quote: Not more than 120 gallons may be stored in any one storage cabinet

answer: Spray-finishing booths must be constructed of noncombustible materials, adequately ventilated, properly electrically classified, and protected against ignition sources. Exhaust systems, filters, housekeeping, flammable-liquid storage, and fire protection must meet the standard’s requirements.
quote: Spray booths shall be substantially constructed of steel or other approved noncombustible material

answer: A process hazard analysis must identify process hazards, previous incidents, engineering and administrative controls, consequences of control failure, facility siting, human factors, and qualitative evaluation of safety and health effects. The PHA must be revalidated at least every 5 years.
quote: At least every five years after the completion of the initial process hazard analysis

answer: General site workers must receive 40 hours of off-site instruction and 3 days of supervised field experience. Occasional workers must receive 24 hours of off-site instruction and 1 day of supervised field experience; supervisors and managers need the applicable worker training plus 8 additional hours.
key_facts: 40 hours and 3 days supervised field experience
24 hours and 1 day supervised field experience
8 additional hours for supervisors and managers
quote: General site workers ... shall receive 40 hours of off-site instruction and a minimum of three days actual field experience

answer: Red must be used for danger, stop, emergency-stop controls, and fire-protection equipment. The standard does not require fire-protection equipment and danger markings to use different colors.
quote: Red shall be the basic color for the identification of fire protection equipment and apparatus

answer: Use danger signs for an immediate hazard that presents a serious threat of death or serious injury. Use caution signs for a potential hazard or unsafe practice that may result in minor or moderate injury.
quote: Danger signs shall be used only where an immediate hazard exists
